Brier: Sum over all three canonical classes of (displayed probability - indicator)^2; arithmetic mean over all 12 retained cases.
NLL_aggregate: Arithmetic mean of negative stable final log probability at retained joined gold class; no clipping.
argmax_policy: Use provided original C,N,E raw-logit first maximum; certificate class first among tied final maxima only for a valid certificate.
derived_log_probability: Apply exactly the same provided-source-raw-logit-winner to certified-class canonical permutation as for displayed T1 probabilities.
uncertainty: Authored formal engineering only; conditional correct-certificate proper-score guarantee applies to the SAME readout, not cross-context performance or benchmark generalization.
